::: {.callout-note}
## Materials coming soon
This page will fill in before the session.
:::

**Designed for** someone with intermediate knowledge of R and RStudio. The first
two modules exist to prepare you for this one.

In this session we will:

- run the analyses that appear most often in papers — **t-tests, chi-squared,
  ANOVA**
- discuss the considerations that **longitudinal datasets like ABCD** force on you,
  including violated normality assumptions and missing data
- introduce **linear models** for testing hypotheses

::: {.callout-important}
Module 3 is a **prerequisite for [Module 4](module4.qmd)**, which is a hands-on
project session assuming you can already choose and run a test.
:::

## Preparation

- [Module 2](module2.qmd), or equivalent comfort with tidyverse pipelines and
  ggplot2
- The missing-data section of [Module 1](module1.qmd#missing-data) — we pick that
  thread up properly here

## Resources

- [longitudinal.dev](https://longitudinal.dev/) — a collection of statistical
  analyses for longitudinal studies
